_note: Racer roster per 01-game/racers.md. base_weight is the relative true-win weight seeding racer_state (data-model.md); volatility is per-race performance variance; drift is how fast the hidden weight wanders week to week. Hidden values never reach the client.

racers.name: Sure Thing
racers.blurb: The favourite. Calm, huge, metronomic. Beats you slowly.

racers.name: Riptide
racers.blurb: Raw speed, zero temperament control. Best and worst racer in the sea, some weeks both.

racers.name: Photo Finish
racers.blurb: Every race she runs ends close. Nobody knows how she does it.

racers.name: Madame Ink
racers.blurb: Tactical. Reads the field, takes the inside line, never panics.

racers.name: Second Wind
racers.blurb: Slow starts, monstrous finishes. Form comes and goes in long cycles.

racers.name: Undertow
racers.blurb: Comes from nowhere, always from behind. Unsettling to bet on, worse to bet against.

racers.name: Commodore
racers.blurb: The dignified veteran. Hasn't changed his pace in years and doesn't intend to.

racers.name: Fine Print
racers.blurb: Methodical, unglamorous, always exactly where the terms said she'd be.

racers.name: Knots
racers.blurb: Tiny, furious, utterly consistent. The mid-field is his kingdom.

racers.name: Moonjelly
racers.blurb: Drifts. Sometimes across the finish line first. Nobody is sure she knows it's a race.

racers.name: Bubbles
racers.blurb: The crowd favourite. Panics, inflates, occasionally wins mid-panic.

racers.name: Barnacle Bill
racers.blurb: Old, encrusted, sideways. Finishes every race he starts, eventually.

racers.name: Long Shot
racers.blurb: Almost never wins. The three times he did are why the stands exist.
